# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

[ View report ][50]

## Creating a world-leading coatings company

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

[ Deal overview ][51] [ Read media release ][52]

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

## Sustainability

We’re always finding new and exciting ways to make our products more sustainable and longer lasting.
Because paint matters – to us, to you and the world around us.

[ Find out more ][59]

## Driving innovation

Our search for better never stops. We’re driven to find innovative, more sustainable solutions for
our customers, communities and the planet. Read on to learn more about our approach to innovation
and recent developments in paints and coatings technology. 

[ Find out more ][60]

#### Collaborations

Discover how we play a progressive role in cross-industry coalitions and consortia to help create a
more sustainable future.
[ Learn more ][61]

#### Partnerships

Meet our partners and learn how we’re rocking the art world with the Rijksmuseum and accelerating
innovation with McLaren.

#### Initiatives

ordinary extraordinary.

[Lighted home with a GAF roof]

## Choose a roofer certified by GAF with confidence

As North America’s largest roofing manufacturer, GAF is an industry leader that produces quality,
innovative roofing materials. Get peace of mind by working with a contractor certified by GAF¹ who
can offer our strongest warranties.
[ Find a contractor ][199]
1Contractors enrolled in GAF certification programs are not employees or agents of GAF, and GAF does
not control or otherwise supervise these independent businesses. Contractors may receive benefits,
such as loyalty rewards points and discounts on marketing tools from GAF for participating in the
program and offering GAF enhanced warranties, which require the use of a minimum amount of GAF
products. Your dealings with a Contractor, and any services they provide to you, are subject to the
[Contractor Terms of Use][200].

## The right solution for any project

### Asphalt shingles

Beauty. Durability. Affordability. Color. Energy efficiency. Whatever your priority, we have your
shingle. Compare residential roofing shingles here.
[ View all shingles ][201]
[GAF certified roofing contractor installing roofing shingles with nail gun]

### Asphaltic system components

A roof system is so much more than shingles. Explore the residential roofing products that make up a
complete roofing system.
[ Residential products ][202]
[GAF Solar roofing contractor in front of home holding solar roof shingles]

### Solar roofing

A beautiful roof. With solar energy. It's that simple. The Timberline Solar™ roofing system is based
on innovations so advanced they make solar simple. Choose a reliable roof, GAF-backed warranties,
and clean energy for your home.
[ Learn about solar ][203]
[Commercial roofing contractor installing GAF TPO]

### TPO roofing systems

Take the hassle out of rooftop challenges with flexible TPO roofing system products and accessories.
[ Explore TPO ][204]
[Contractor rolling coating on flat roof]

### Roof coating systems

GAF liquid-applied roofing system solutions create a seamless barrier to weather elements. They can
be installed over most existing roof types, reducing the need for tear-offs for structurally sound
roofs, or installation of cover boards.
[ Coatings resources ][205]
[Roofing contractor applying asphaltic materials on a flat roof]

### Low-slope asphalt solutions

Asphalt roofing systems consist of two or more waterproofing layers. This redundancy provides
building owners with durable waterproofing protection.
[ View asphalt solutions ][206]

## Choose a roofer certified by GAF with confidence

As North America’s largest roofing manufacturer, GAF is an industry leader that produces quality,
innovative roofing materials. Get peace of mind by working with a contractor certified by GAF¹ who
can offer our strongest warranties.
[ Find a contractor ][199]
1Contractors enrolled in GAF certification programs are not employees or agents of GAF, and GAF does
not control or otherwise supervise these independent businesses. Contractors may receive benefits,
such as loyalty rewards points and discounts on marketing tools from GAF for participating in the
program and offering GAF enhanced warranties, which require the use of a minimum amount of GAF
products. Your dealings with a Contractor, and any services they provide to you, are subject to the
[Contractor Terms of Use][200].

## The right solution for any project

### Asphalt shingles

Beauty. Durability. Affordability. Color. Energy efficiency. Whatever your priority, we have your
shingle. Compare residential roofing shingles here.
[ View all shingles ][201]
[GAF certified roofing contractor installing roofing shingles with nail gun]

### Asphaltic system components

A roof system is so much more than shingles. Explore the residential roofing products that make up a
complete roofing system.
[ Residential products ][202]
[GAF Solar roofing contractor in front of home holding solar roof shingles]

### Solar roofing

A beautiful roof. With solar energy. It's that simple. The Timberline Solar™ roofing system is based
on innovations so advanced they make solar simple. Choose a reliable roof, GAF-backed warranties,
and clean energy for your home.
[ Learn about solar ][203]
[Commercial roofing contractor installing GAF TPO]

### TPO roofing systems

Take the hassle out of rooftop challenges with flexible TPO roofing system products and accessories.
[ Explore TPO ][204]
[Contractor rolling coating on flat roof]

### Roof coating systems

GAF liquid-applied roofing system solutions create a seamless barrier to weather elements. They can
be installed over most existing roof types, reducing the need for tear-offs for structurally sound
roofs, or installation of cover boards.
[ Coatings resources ][205]
[Roofing contractor applying asphaltic materials on a flat roof]

### Low-slope asphalt solutions

Asphalt roofing systems consist of two or more waterproofing layers. This redundancy provides
building owners with durable waterproofing protection.
[ View asphalt solutions ][206]

### Forefront of Innovation

Combining PPG’s expertise in coatings and technologies to aid automakers around the world in
enhancing the image and identity of their vehicle brands.

Learn More

### Breakthrough Performance

When it comes to building durability, increasing performance or enhancing appearance, PPG's refinish
business owns a track record of success no other company can match.

Learn More

## Industrial Coatings

### Tomorrow Realized

Leading manufacturers trust PPG’s global color stylists, chemists and technical application experts
to provide the innovative coatings that enhance the products we use every day.

### Leading the Pack

For decades, PPG’s research and development experts have created coatings that have made products
better across nearly every industry, from food and beverage, to cosmetics and personal care, to
paints and chemicals.

and environments, including civil infrastructure, offshore, petrochemical, power, marine new-build,

The broad, global portfolio of pavement markings and traffic safety solutions includes paint,
thermoplastics and other advanced traffic technologies, which help keep motorists, cyclists, road

## Aerospace

### Engineered for Performance

Delivering new technologies for transparencies, coatings, sealants, packaging, and chemical
management for the aviation industries.

Learn More

## Automotive OEM

### Forefront of Innovation

Combining PPG’s expertise in coatings and technologies to aid automakers around the world in
enhancing the image and identity of their vehicle brands.

Learn More

## Automotive Refinish

### Breakthrough Performance

When it comes to building durability, increasing performance or enhancing appearance, PPG's refinish
business owns a track record of success no other company can match.

Learn More

## Industrial Coatings

### Tomorrow Realized

Leading manufacturers trust PPG’s global color stylists, chemists and technical application experts
to provide the innovative coatings that enhance the products we use every day.

Learn More

## Packaging Coatings

### Leading the Pack

For decades, PPG’s research and development experts have created coatings that have made products
better across nearly every industry, from food and beverage, to cosmetics and personal care, to
paints and chemicals. 

Learn More

## Protective & Marine Coatings

### Unrivaled Performance

Developing products that protect customers’ assets in some of the world’s most demanding conditions
and environments, including civil infrastructure, offshore, petrochemical, power, marine new-build,
marine dry dock and marine sea stock.

Learn More

## Traffic Solutions

### Performance that protects

The broad, global portfolio of pavement markings and traffic safety solutions includes paint,
thermoplastics and other advanced traffic technologies, which help keep motorists, cyclists, road
workers and pedestrians safe in our communities.

Learn More
[Image of a freshly painted lane on a 6-lane roadway, with large green horizontal stripes.]

## Specialty Products

### SOLVING COMPLEX PROBLEMS WITH UNIQUE SOLUTIONS

## Optical Monomers and Coatings


Eyeglass lens technologies that enhance and protect vision.

Learn More

## PPG TESLIN® Substrate


A high-performance material used for product labels, ID cards and more.

Learn More

## Filtration Technologies


An innovative new technology that make the sustainable recovery of industrial process water and
wastewater more efficient and economical.

Learn More

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

### Building Envelope Systems for Any Project

Our building material systems are designed to work together for a continuous, air-tight and
waterproof solution in the most extreme environmental conditions.



Air Barrier Systems

Comprehensive air barrier systems protecting against air and moisture infiltration with self-adhered
and fluid-applied membranes, sealants, flashings and transition assemblies.

Commercial Glazing Systems

Everything you need for air- and watertight fenestration and wall assemblies in new construction or
restoration applications.  

Traffic Systems

Liquid-applied waterproofing membranes for vehicular and pedestrian applications, delivering
long-term durability in high-traffic areas.

Waterproofing

We provide fluid-applied, sheet-applied, and hybrid waterproofing systems with primers, drainage,
and other accessories for maximum below-grade protection.

PUMA Technology

Traffic and waterproofing systems featuring PUMA (polyurethane-methacrylate) technology for
exceptional abrasion resistance, crack-bridging and fast cure.

### Building Envelope Systems for Any Project

Our building material systems are designed to work together for a continuous, air-tight and
waterproof solution in the most extreme environmental conditions.



Air Barrier Systems

Comprehensive air barrier systems protecting against air and moisture infiltration with self-adhered
and fluid-applied membranes, sealants, flashings and transition assemblies.

Commercial Glazing Systems

Everything you need for air- and watertight fenestration and wall assemblies in new construction or
restoration applications.  

Traffic Systems

Liquid-applied waterproofing membranes for vehicular and pedestrian applications, delivering
long-term durability in high-traffic areas.

Waterproofing

We provide fluid-applied, sheet-applied, and hybrid waterproofing systems with primers, drainage,
and other accessories for maximum below-grade protection.

PUMA Technology

Traffic and waterproofing systems featuring PUMA (polyurethane-methacrylate) technology for
exceptional abrasion resistance, crack-bridging and fast cure.

and integrity is at the heart of what we do. In addition to industry leading products, our technical

roof you ever have to install.

Kynar^{®}, Acrymax enhances the entire building.

## ENGINEERED COATING SOLUTIONS TO EXCEED YOUR EXPECTATIONS

We engineer and customize coatings to meet the unique demands of specific applications. Our coatings
protect everything from rockets to buildings, providing extreme performance and durability. Acrymax
provides the coatings you need!

[Slate-Roofing-Repair.jpg]

Alas & Bravo is a roofing contractor that is located in Irvine, and serves all of Orange County.

 

We simplify what is out of reach for our clients through the close communication we establish during

We provide guidance and a great understanding of any type of roof repair, maintenance, or
installation.

 

One of the most important components to the longevity of a roof is the craftsmanship that goes into
it, not the cost of the brand or style of the materials.

 

It also requires an awareness of a home’s environment and community. By choosing our team to work
with you, you can expect the craftsmanship of a fine installation and the security that comes from

A quality finish is never luck — it’s preparation. The lasting beauty of your home is decided before
the color ever goes on, in the groundwork most homeowners never see. It’s the meticulous detail work
many painters rush through, and the part we take most seriously.

Before a brush ever moves, we fix what decides how a finish will look, bond, and last — filling
[stucco cracks][140], replacing rotted fascia and trim, repairing [James Hardie® or T1-11
siding][141], and patching drywall, then matching texture, sealing, caulking, and priming until the
surface is sound. It’s the prep most painters rush or skip — and it shows up close: sharper lines,
stronger adhesion, and a finish that lasts.

From there, we paint with high-quality **Sherwin-Williams® and Benjamin Moore®** coatings — rich,
durable finishes selected for each surface and environment. Whether you’re refreshing an
[interior][142] or transforming your [exterior][143], you get clean lines, careful protection, and a
finish built to stand up to Florida’s sun, humidity, rain, and coastal salt air.

For homeowners and businesses across **Jacksonville, Ponte Vedra Beach, St. Augustine, Fleming
Island, Nocatee, and Northeast Florida**, we don’t just paint what shows. We prepare what matters
underneath.

Serving Northeast Florida since 2001

A New Leaf Painting backs every project with our **No-Chaos process**, [750+ verified 5-star
reviews][144], and our **Iron-Clad Guarantee**. Less mess, less stress, and a beautifully painted
home protected from start to finish.

## Professional Protection

APOC is the destination for professional grade commercial and residential building products of all
kinds - roof coatings, adhesives, waterproofing solutions and more.

[Learn More][101]

## NEW! Coverage Calculator

We'll help you define the right coating, coverage, and warranty - based on your roof surface and
project goals.

[Get Started][102]

## The Quality Standards You Know and Trust

APOC Polyset AH-160 has been reformulated with a low global warming potential (GWP) blowing agent to
meet the nationwide regulations while staying true to the features and benefits you are familiar
with.

[Learn More][103]

## Become a Certified Applicator

Designed specifically for contractors, our programs educate on APOC products and systems, bring
awareness of new technologies and application techniques, and more! Click below to check the
training schedule and sign up today.

[Learn More][104]

## Get Rewarded For Your Loyalty!

Check out our new loyalty program where contractors can earn points for purchases, marketing
support, and more! 

[Learn More][105]

these products can greatly extend the life of the existing roof. With a focus on quality and
innovation, APOC products have set the standard for the industry.

APOC is the destination for professional grade commercial and residential building products of all

meet the nationwide regulations while staying true to the features and benefits you are familiar
with.

support, and more!

#### Latest Video

#### Who we are

At [Belzona][184], our combination of cutting-edge research and development allows us to develop the
latest in [polymer systems][185]. Alongside the unrivalled experience of our people, we can meet the
ever-changing and challenging demands of industry.

We are committed to providing bespoke solutions, technical support and on-site assistance tailored
to each client's specific needs. Available through a [global network of Distributors][186],
supported by our headquarters in [UK, USA, Canada and Thailand][187], our engineered solutions come
with international accreditations and a proven track record in performance.

Belzona provides a [truly global service][188], supplying repair and refurbishment services, coating
inspection and application training on a local level. This is all to one purpose; to ensure our
clients have the best materials to protect their plant and equipment for the long term, reducing
downtime and lowering maintenance costs.

#### What we do

Specialising in the design and manufacture of repair composite materials and protective coatings for
machinery, equipment, buildings and structures, Belzona offers the solution to an extensive range of
engineering problems and repair situations.

Simple, safe and effective solutions allow us to assist with demanding projects by providing
benefits rarely found elsewhere, including minimised downtime, reduced health and safety risks and
simple application techniques.

When making an investment in Belzona technology, you get more than just the product. An intrinsic
part of Belzona's success is our commitment to not only providing high-performance solutions, but
always going above and beyond as a 'Product Plus' service provider. Whether it's tailor-made product
specifications, onsite training, ongoing technical support or aftercare, we pride ourselves in
providing a comprehensive support package to fulfil all of our clients' needs.

To discover [Belzona's products][189], the [industries we serve][190] or specific details on our
[application areas][191], [contact us][192] directly or [find your local Distributor][193].

#### Latest Video

#### Who we are

At [Belzona][184], our combination of cutting-edge research and development allows us to develop the
latest in [polymer systems][185]. Alongside the unrivalled experience of our people, we can meet the
ever-changing and challenging demands of industry.

We are committed to providing bespoke solutions, technical support and on-site assistance tailored
to each client's specific needs. Available through a [global network of Distributors][186],
supported by our headquarters in [UK, USA, Canada and Thailand][187], our engineered solutions come
with international accreditations and a proven track record in performance.

Belzona provides a [truly global service][188], supplying repair and refurbishment services, coating
inspection and application training on a local level. This is all to one purpose; to ensure our
clients have the best materials to protect their plant and equipment for the long term, reducing
downtime and lowering maintenance costs.

#### What we do

Specialising in the design and manufacture of repair composite materials and protective coatings for
machinery, equipment, buildings and structures, Belzona offers the solution to an extensive range of
engineering problems and repair situations.

Simple, safe and effective solutions allow us to assist with demanding projects by providing
benefits rarely found elsewhere, including minimised downtime, reduced health and safety risks and
simple application techniques.

When making an investment in Belzona technology, you get more than just the product. An intrinsic
part of Belzona's success is our commitment to not only providing high-performance solutions, but
always going above and beyond as a 'Product Plus' service provider. Whether it's tailor-made product
specifications, onsite training, ongoing technical support or aftercare, we pride ourselves in
providing a comprehensive support package to fulfil all of our clients' needs.

To discover [Belzona's products][189], the [industries we serve][190] or specific details on our
[application areas][191], [contact us][192] directly or [find your local Distributor][193].

## PRODUCTS

### Anti-Fouling

A range of high-tech anti-fouling products offering protection with products suited for all
conditions and requirements with guaranteed performance.

[Daily anti-aging cream][47]

### Primers

Full range of primers for all substrates, above and below waterline, providing excellent adhesion,
protection and solid foundation for the following coatings.

### Fillers

Comprehensive range of fillers, to suit all customers and market needs with proven track record,
offering the lightest and most flexible superyacht filler on the market.

### Undercoats

A range of products designed to provide the best surfaces for finishing and topcoats that promote
adhesion, with excellent sanding properties and offer a stable base for colour depth and longevity.

### Topcoats

Topcoat product to suit all needs, offered in a range of colours, with good colour stability, UV
resistance and high gloss finish. The best finish for any surface that requires long lasting
protection and colour.

### Challenger PRO

Premium range of topcoat products, offering a versatile assortment of finishes and colours with
either single or base & clearcoat systems, including metallics and special effects. A range of
solvents and additives are included for a variety of application conditions and repairs.

### Varnishes

A range of wood treatments and varnishes, to preserve and enhance the beauty of wood finish in the
harsh marine environment.

### Tank Coatings

Range of specialist tank coatings, to suit the toughest requirements, all with recognised
certification.

### Other Products

Range of additions products required for various painting and specialist tasks.

### Durepox

Durepox is a cutting-edge epoxy urethane primer known for its fast application and superior
adhesion. Used by top racing teams.

[Daily anti-aging cream][48]

## SUPERYACHT

Boero YachtCoatings offer an integrated and comprehensive range of customised coating solutions and
services in order to meet the most complex requirements. From the design, development and building
of a new yacht, the yacht aftersales support during service, to the maintenance in drydock or refit,
we stand by our customers during the entire boat lifecycle at every stage.

[Discover Superyachts][49]

## DEALER NETWORK

Boero YachtCoatings has a specialised network of dealers in the key yachting locations, each
providing the highest standard of service, stock and support to the yachting market.
Challenger Mix, the tintometric colour system of Challenger Pro topcoats, is available in a growing
number of locations, offering customers Challenger Pro topcoat colours in solid, metallic and
special effect finishes.

[Dealer List][50]

## TRAINING ACADEMY

Boero has a training academy, for the education and training of customers and staff. With a mix of
courses for different customer types, the Academy offers both theory and practical course in many
specialist area of yacht coatings, from yachting product range induction to specialist spray
finishes.
The Academy offers courses in our training centre, or in the field and on-site. The fully equipped
training centre as all the latest application tools and equipment for the demonstration of a single
specialist product to the full range of a typical yacht coating systems. Highly qualified trainers
are on hand to introduce the products, demonstrate, train or guide on the best application methods
to ensure the best possible results from the wide range of product technologies.

## PREFERRED SUPPLIER

Boero YachtCoatings are the preferred choice, as we ensure our customers have the best custom
coating solutions, from the full and versatile range of product, superior performance for any type
of substrate, application and conditions, all supported by the Boero technical team and product
warranty

### Boero LifeCycle

An integrated and comprehensive range of customised coating solutions and services to meet the most
complex requirements.

We promote the Boero LifeCycle with a dedicated team, focused on the best maintenance and aftersales
service to superyacht: shipyards, captains and management, offering global support, product
information and service. We support the Boero LifeCycle with our technical services, offering
practical coatings advice, specification, inspection and various levels of training.

[Discover Boero LifeCycle][41]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

### Boero Technical Service

Boero YachtCoatings actively engages in customer service by taking our involvement with our
customers past the point of the actual sale of our products into the shipyard, dry dock,
construction site and workshops to assist our customers obtain the required coating finish and to
conform to the project coating specification.
Boero YachtCoatings achieves this in field service by employing a dedicated group of qualified
staff, known as Boero Coating Advisors. Boero Coating Advisors are located in most of the markets
where Boero YachtCoatings is promoting and selling products, being part of the local technical
service team and report to the local Technical Service Manager.

[Discover Techical Services][42]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

### Full range of products

Boero YachtCoatings has a comprehensive range of products and coating solutions that cover all
requirements for both yacht and superyacht painting. Coatings that cover above and below waterline,
exterior and interior systems and all types of tanks and specialist areas.
With a variety of product options in each product group: Anti-fouling, Fillers, Primers, Tank
coatings and Topcoats – Boero YachtCoatings has a coating solution to suit all needs, offering
performance in the most demanding of environments.
Boero YachtCoatings offer complete coating systems to suit a variety of uses, application,
environmental conditions and expected finish.

[Discover Products][43]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

[Boero YachtCoatings]

## PRODUCTS

### Anti-Fouling

A range of high-tech anti-fouling products offering protection with products suited for all
conditions and requirements with guaranteed performance.

[Daily anti-aging cream][47]

### Primers

Full range of primers for all substrates, above and below waterline, providing excellent adhesion,
protection and solid foundation for the following coatings.

### Fillers

Comprehensive range of fillers, to suit all customers and market needs with proven track record,
offering the lightest and most flexible superyacht filler on the market.

### Undercoats

A range of products designed to provide the best surfaces for finishing and topcoats that promote
adhesion, with excellent sanding properties and offer a stable base for colour depth and longevity.

### Topcoats

Topcoat product to suit all needs, offered in a range of colours, with good colour stability, UV
resistance and high gloss finish. The best finish for any surface that requires long lasting
protection and colour.

### Challenger PRO

Premium range of topcoat products, offering a versatile assortment of finishes and colours with
either single or base & clearcoat systems, including metallics and special effects. A range of
solvents and additives are included for a variety of application conditions and repairs.

### Varnishes

A range of wood treatments and varnishes, to preserve and enhance the beauty of wood finish in the
harsh marine environment.

### Tank Coatings

Range of specialist tank coatings, to suit the toughest requirements, all with recognised
certification.

### Other Products

Range of additions products required for various painting and specialist tasks.

### Durepox

Durepox is a cutting-edge epoxy urethane primer known for its fast application and superior
adhesion. Used by top racing teams.

[Daily anti-aging cream][48]

## SUPERYACHT

Boero YachtCoatings offer an integrated and comprehensive range of customised coating solutions and
services in order to meet the most complex requirements. From the design, development and building
of a new yacht, the yacht aftersales support during service, to the maintenance in drydock or refit,
we stand by our customers during the entire boat lifecycle at every stage.

[Discover Superyachts][49]

## DEALER NETWORK

Boero YachtCoatings has a specialised network of dealers in the key yachting locations, each
providing the highest standard of service, stock and support to the yachting market.
Challenger Mix, the tintometric colour system of Challenger Pro topcoats, is available in a growing
number of locations, offering customers Challenger Pro topcoat colours in solid, metallic and
special effect finishes.

[Dealer List][50]

## TRAINING ACADEMY

Boero has a training academy, for the education and training of customers and staff. With a mix of
courses for different customer types, the Academy offers both theory and practical course in many
specialist area of yacht coatings, from yachting product range induction to specialist spray
finishes.
The Academy offers courses in our training centre, or in the field and on-site. The fully equipped
training centre as all the latest application tools and equipment for the demonstration of a single
specialist product to the full range of a typical yacht coating systems. Highly qualified trainers
are on hand to introduce the products, demonstrate, train or guide on the best application methods
to ensure the best possible results from the wide range of product technologies.

# Service at Your Fingertips

Build a spec-ready, NFPA 285 compliant wall with our easy-to-use app.

**[Click Here to Build a Wall][55]**

)

# MiraPLY-H with SeamLOCK^{™} Technology

See the science behind the new MiraPLY-H with SeamLOCK^{ }Technology.

**[Click Here to See MiraPLY-H in Action][56]**


)

# Beat the Heat WITH MiraSEAL^{™}

No kettles! Odor free. 100% solids. Fluid-applied waterproofing membrane. 20-year warranty.
**
[Click Here to View MiraSEAL v. Traditional Systems][57]**

)

# Energy Efficiency. Indoor Comfort.

Air and vapor barriers are critical to building longevity. As an innovator in AVB technology, CCW
was the first manufacturer to offer a full line of AVB products tested to NFPA 285 standards. 
)

# R2+^{®} Polyiso Insulation

CCW's R2+ polyiso wall insulation products work together with CCW air and vapor barrier systems to
create a total wall system that protects your building from moisture infiltration while keeping your
building well insulated and reducing energy costs. 
)

# Looking for AIA Credits?

Learn the latest technology in waterproofing, weather barriers, wall systems, and green roofs. 

[Click Here to Earn Credits][58]
)

# HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE. LEAKS.
# STRUCTURAL DAMAGE.

Shop the progressive destruction caused by groundwater seepage with MiraDRAIN aggregate-free damage
solutions. Each MiraDRAIN system allows multiple flow paths for water to pass freely into the
drainage core.

)

# NFPA 285 Approved Air and Vapor Barriers

The Fire Resist line borrows technology from the aerospace industry to produce the only fluid- and
sheet-applied air and vapor barriers that can pass the tough National Fire Protection Association
(NFPA) 285 standards.
* • Fire Resist Barritech NP
* • Fire Resist Barritech VP
* • Fire Resist Barritech VP-LT
* • Fire Resist 705 VP
* • Fire Resist 705 FR-A

)

# Reduce Rooftop Temperatures.

# Improve Building and Energy Efficiency.

These are just a few of a myriad of reasons Green Roof Systems are gaining popularity in the United
States. We offer traditional and modular systems engineered to fit your specific needs.

)

# New high-tack universal and low-temp seasonal adhesives!

)

# Single-Source Warranty

Why deal with multiple vendors when CCW offers a Single Source Warranty for up to 20 years? With
CCW, building owners can trust that the entire building envelope is backed up by the financial
resources of Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM) which manufacturers a complete range of
commercial roofing and waterproofing products.

Canada
June 4 - 5, 2025 | Ontario, Canada
Canadian Mining Expo 2025

We are excited to announce our participation in the **2025 Canadian Mining Expo**, taking place on
**June 4-5, 2025**, at the **McIntyre Complex in Timmins, Ontario**. This premier event, featuring
over **400 exhibits**, is a key platform for showcasing the latest innovations, products, and
services in the mining industry.

Visit us to explore our advanced **maintenance, repair, and wear protection solutions**, designed to
enhance efficiency and sustainability in mining operations. Connect with our team to discuss how we
can support your business in tackling the industry’s evolving challenges.

**Find more details here:** [Canadian Mining Expo 2025][252]

[tradeshow_drc]
Congo - Kinshasa
June 11 - 15, 2025 | Lubumbashi, Congo - Kinshasa
DRC Mining Week Expo & Conference 2025

**Join Castolin Eutectic at DRC Mining Week 2025 – Connecting Innovation and Opportunity**
From **June 11-13, 2025**, at the **Grand Karavia Hotel, Lubumbashi**, Castolin Eutectic is proud to
participate in **DRC Mining Week**, Africa's premier platform for fostering innovation,
collaboration, and sustainable progress in the mining sector.

Aligned with the event’s mission to unite people, organizations, and resources, we will showcase our
advanced solutions in **maintenance, repair, and wear protection**, designed to meet the evolving
challenges of Africa’s mining industry. Together, we can shape a brighter, more connected, and
sustainable future for mining and beyond.

Find more details here: [DRC Mining Week Expo & Conference 2025][253]

International Exhibition of Railway Technology**, taking place from **June 24-26, 2025**, at **Lille
Grand Palais, Lille, France**. This premier event is a key platform for showcasing the latest
innovations, products, and services in the railway industry.

Visit us to explore our **advanced maintenance, repair, and wear protection solutions**, designed to
enhance **efficiency, durability, and sustainability** in railway operations.

June 4 - 5, 2025 | Ontario, Canada
Canadian Mining Expo 2025

We are excited to announce our participation in the **2025 Canadian Mining Expo**, taking place on
**June 4-5, 2025**, at the **McIntyre Complex in Timmins, Ontario**. This premier event, featuring
over **400 exhibits**, is a key platform for showcasing the latest innovations, products, and
services in the mining industry.

Visit us to explore our advanced **maintenance, repair, and wear protection solutions**, designed to
enhance efficiency and sustainability in mining operations. Connect with our team to discuss how we
can support your business in tackling the industry’s evolving challenges.

**Find more details here:** [Canadian Mining Expo 2025][252]

June 11 - 15, 2025 | Lubumbashi, Congo - Kinshasa
DRC Mining Week Expo & Conference 2025

**Join Castolin Eutectic at DRC Mining Week 2025 – Connecting Innovation and Opportunity**
From **June 11-13, 2025**, at the **Grand Karavia Hotel, Lubumbashi**, Castolin Eutectic is proud to
participate in **DRC Mining Week**, Africa's premier platform for fostering innovation,
collaboration, and sustainable progress in the mining sector.

Aligned with the event’s mission to unite people, organizations, and resources, we will showcase our
advanced solutions in **maintenance, repair, and wear protection**, designed to meet the evolving
challenges of Africa’s mining industry. Together, we can shape a brighter, more connected, and
sustainable future for mining and beyond.

Find more details here: [DRC Mining Week Expo & Conference 2025][253]

customer like family because we truly appreciate you choosing us! Learn more about us by calling
today at [(678) 365-3138][103].

### Roof Repair Vs. Replacement: Making The Right Decision

Determining whether to repair or [replace your roof][104] is a crucial decision that impacts the
safety, value, and longevity of your home. Colony Roofers is here to provide you with the insights
you need to make an informed choice based on the condition of your roof, your budget, and your
long-term goals.

### When to Choose Roof Repair
* **Localized Damage:** If your roofing issues are limited to a specific area or a few shingles, a
  repair might be a cost-effective solution to address the problem without the need for a complete
  replacement.
* **Recent Damage:** For newer roofs with minor damage caused by a recent event, like a storm or
  fallen branch, repairs can often restore the integrity of your roof without requiring a full
  replacement.
* **Budget Considerations:** Repairing isolated problems can be more budget-friendly in the short
  term, especially if your roof is relatively new and hasn't yet reached the end of its lifespan.
* **Maintenance and Maintenance History:** Regular maintenance and timely repairs can extend the
  life of your roof. If you've diligently maintained your roof and are dealing with minor issues,
  repairs might be sufficient.

### When to Consider Roof Replacement
* **Advanced Age:** If your roof is approaching its expected lifespan and is showing signs of
  deterioration, a replacement may be the smarter long-term investment compared to continuous
  repairs.
* **Extensive Damage:** If your roof has widespread damage, such as multiple leaks, sagging areas,
  or severely deteriorated shingles, a replacement may be necessary to ensure your home's structural
  integrity.
* **Cost of Repairs:** If the cost of repairing multiple issues is close to the cost of a
  replacement, it may make more financial sense to invest in a new roof that offers improved
  performance and longevity.
* **Energy Efficiency and Upgrades:** A replacement provides an opportunity to upgrade to more
  energy-efficient roofing materials, insulation, and ventilation systems that can result in
  long-term energy savings.
* **Curb Appeal and Home Value:** If your roof's appearance is significantly detracting from your
  home's curb appeal, a new roof can improve aesthetics and increase your property's value.
* **Consistent Problems:** If you find yourself frequently dealing with repairs due to recurring
  issues, a replacement can offer peace of mind by eliminating the need for constant maintenance.

### Consulting the Professionals

Colony Roofers recommends consulting with our experienced professionals to assess the condition of
your roof. Our experts will conduct a comprehensive evaluation, considering factors like age, damage
extent, budget, and your future plans. With our guidance, you'll receive honest recommendations
tailored to your unique situation, helping you make the best choice for your home and your family.

Whether you opt for a repair or replacement, Colony Roofers is dedicated to delivering top-notch
solutions that prioritize your safety, comfort, and satisfaction. Our commitment to quality
workmanship ensures that your roofing project is in capable hands, resulting in a roof that meets
your needs and exceeds your expectations.

### Looking For Locally Owned Atlanta Roofing Companies?

Don’t worry, we’ve got you covered! Literally, we are the roofers in Atlanta, GA. In fact, we will
make your roof better than ever before! Whether it’s our upgraded HD architectural shingles at no
added cost, or the addition of ridge vents to make your home comfortable and cool in the summer
months, we make sure to get you the most for your money. Our experienced team can handle any [roof
pitch][105], from steep slopes to low-angle roofs. 

Our first step, as one of the most reputable **Atlanta roofing companies**, will be to assess any
damage to your roof and tell you what we would do, whether that’s a big or little job. Second, we’ll
lay out all of your options so you can decide what’s best for you. You can feel good knowing we’ve
gone over every detail. That’s why Colony Roofers is your Atlanta, GA Roofers. Whether a roof
replacement, roof repair, or any other roofing needs, we’re here for you. To get started, all you

### Roof Repair Vs. Replacement: Making The Right Decision

Determining whether to repair or [replace your roof][104] is a crucial decision that impacts the
safety, value, and longevity of your home. Colony Roofers is here to provide you with the insights
you need to make an informed choice based on the condition of your roof, your budget, and your
long-term goals.

### When to Choose Roof Repair
* **Localized Damage:** If your roofing issues are limited to a specific area or a few shingles, a
  repair might be a cost-effective solution to address the problem without the need for a complete
  replacement.
* **Recent Damage:** For newer roofs with minor damage caused by a recent event, like a storm or
  fallen branch, repairs can often restore the integrity of your roof without requiring a full
  replacement.
* **Budget Considerations:** Repairing isolated problems can be more budget-friendly in the short
  term, especially if your roof is relatively new and hasn't yet reached the end of its lifespan.
* **Maintenance and Maintenance History:** Regular maintenance and timely repairs can extend the
  life of your roof. If you've diligently maintained your roof and are dealing with minor issues,
  repairs might be sufficient.

### When to Consider Roof Replacement
* **Advanced Age:** If your roof is approaching its expected lifespan and is showing signs of
  deterioration, a replacement may be the smarter long-term investment compared to continuous
  repairs.
* **Extensive Damage:** If your roof has widespread damage, such as multiple leaks, sagging areas,
  or severely deteriorated shingles, a replacement may be necessary to ensure your home's structural
  integrity.
* **Cost of Repairs:** If the cost of repairing multiple issues is close to the cost of a
  replacement, it may make more financial sense to invest in a new roof that offers improved
  performance and longevity.
* **Energy Efficiency and Upgrades:** A replacement provides an opportunity to upgrade to more
  energy-efficient roofing materials, insulation, and ventilation systems that can result in
  long-term energy savings.
* **Curb Appeal and Home Value:** If your roof's appearance is significantly detracting from your
  home's curb appeal, a new roof can improve aesthetics and increase your property's value.
* **Consistent Problems:** If you find yourself frequently dealing with repairs due to recurring
  issues, a replacement can offer peace of mind by eliminating the need for constant maintenance.

### Consulting the Professionals

Colony Roofers recommends consulting with our experienced professionals to assess the condition of
your roof. Our experts will conduct a comprehensive evaluation, considering factors like age, damage
extent, budget, and your future plans. With our guidance, you'll receive honest recommendations

# Colorama Coatings

### Not just paint, but real protection

Over the past 25 years we have developed an extensive range of high-quality paints and coatings
utilising the latest manufacturing technology aided by a strong research and development ethos. Our
products are used in a number of industrial, retail, housing and hospitality settings in Egypt and
around the world.

## Pioneering excellence in coatings Since 1997

Founded in 1997 with the establishment of our paints factory in Borg El Arab Industrial City,
Alexandria, Egypt, Colorama Coatings has evolved into a key player in the coatings industry in
Egypt. Through strategic collaborations with leading European and American multinational companies,
we’ve expanded our product range beyond architectural and decorative paints to include specialised
industrial, protective, and marine coating systems. Our commitment to quality through innovation has
driven our continuous growth, transforming Colorama into an agile organisation capable of swiftly
responding to market demands and customer requirements.

## Innovation-driven quality protection coatings

Today, Colorama Coatings stands as a leader in protection technology, made possible by our dedicated
R&D team in Egypt and partnerships with premier formulators across Europe and the USA. This ardent
focus on research enables us to develop bespoke solutions for any coating challenge, precisely
tailored to fulfil diverse customer specifications. Our elastomeric coatings rival those of
internationally renowned brands, delivering equivalent performance at competitive value. Advanced
thermal and waterproofing coating systems represent the latest addition to our comprehensive product
portfolio, specifically engineered to meet the rigorous demands of the petrochemical and energy
industries.

# Colorama Coatings

### Not just paint, but real protection

Over the past 25 years we have developed an extensive range of high-quality paints and coatings
utilising the latest manufacturing technology aided by a strong research and development ethos. Our
products are used in a number of industrial, retail, housing and hospitality settings in Egypt and
around the world.

## Pioneering excellence in coatings Since 1997

Founded in 1997 with the establishment of our paints factory in Borg El Arab Industrial City,
Alexandria, Egypt, Colorama Coatings has evolved into a key player in the coatings industry in
Egypt. Through strategic collaborations with leading European and American multinational companies,
we’ve expanded our product range beyond architectural and decorative paints to include specialised
industrial, protective, and marine coating systems. Our commitment to quality through innovation has
driven our continuous growth, transforming Colorama into an agile organisation capable of swiftly
responding to market demands and customer requirements.

## Innovation-driven quality protection coatings

Today, Colorama Coatings stands as a leader in protection technology, made possible by our dedicated
R&D team in Egypt and partnerships with premier formulators across Europe and the USA. This ardent
focus on research enables us to develop bespoke solutions for any coating challenge, precisely
tailored to fulfil diverse customer specifications. Our elastomeric coatings rival those of
internationally renowned brands, delivering equivalent performance at competitive value. Advanced
thermal and waterproofing coating systems represent the latest addition to our comprehensive product
portfolio, specifically engineered to meet the rigorous demands of the petrochemical and energy
industries.

## CERTIFCATES

## Our products

###### Resins & Alkyds

We supply high quality alkyds to our coatings’ plants and other customers as well as epoxy,
polyurethane and acrylic resin.

[ DETAILS ][48]

###### Wood coatings

We produce a range of wood paints and varnishes designed for enhancing appearance, durability and
performance.

[ DETAILS ][49]

###### Decorative coatings

Our acclaimed and versatile interior and exterior range of paints are designed for durability and
harsh environmental conditions.

[ DETAILS ][50]

###### Roof coatings

Our Elastomeric and Acrylic roof coatings offer an excellent protective layer and are designed to
enhance performance, appearance and durability.

[ DETAILS ][51]

###### Marine coatings

Marine coatings are specialised protective paints designed to safeguard ships, boats, and offshore
structures from harsh marine environments.

[ DETAILS ][52]

###### Industrial coatings

Our industrial coatings range is used in various applications including protection from corrosion,
chemical and environmental damage.

[ DETAILS ][53]

###### Thermal insulation coatings

These coating are designed to provide thermal protection for tanks, vessels, boilers, pipelines as
well as roof and warehouse insulation.

[ DETAILS ][54]

###### Fireproofing coatings

We supply fire protection water-based acrylic intumescent paints for protecting structural steel as
well as epoxies for wood and textile protection.

[ DETAILS ][55]

###### Floor coatings

Our floor coatings provide enhanced performance, appearance and durability for factory floors and
other heavily trafficked areas.

Creative Coatings Acquisition and Introduction:

We are back!

For the past 3 months, the four of us ([Chris Stevenson][43], [Bobby Malaczewski][44], Joseph Creek,
and [Jesse Creek][45]) have been working together towards purchasing Creative Coatings, and that
goal has finally become a reality. As of September 1st, we have acquired the [Creative Coatings
Co.][46]

What this means is that the four of us, along with Ron Plonkey, Anthony Citraro, and Mike Marsee,
will make up the new Creative Coatings Company. Rich Plonkey will be staying on temporarily to help
ease the transition. All of our products will continue to ship from the Michigan facility, giving us
a strong, centrally located distribution center for our expanding product offerings. Creative
Coatings Company will now be official distributors for the following product lines:

-AkzoNobel Aerospace Coatings- full tier 1 distributor
-Hentzen Coatings- full distributor
-NCP Coatings- full distributor

In addition to the above, Creative Coatings will now begin to fully stock a wide variety of coatings
and products from the following companies:

-PPG Aerospace- fully stocking both Deft and PPG Legacy items
-Spectrum Coatings

As a result, Creative Coatings Company will be increasing our inventory and carrying a wider, more
diverse selection of products from all five companies. We strive to maintain the fast turnaround
times, competitive pricing, superior customer service, and industry experience you’ve received in
the past. With over 100 years combined experience between the seven of us, we want Creative Coatings
to become the “creative” solution to all your aerospace coating needs.

Feel free to call or email us with any questions you may have regarding this transition.

We look forward to hearing back from you, and we would love the opportunity to earn your business!

August 31, 2023

Creative Coatings Acquisition and Introduction:

We are back!

For the past 3 months, the four of us ([Chris Stevenson][43], [Bobby Malaczewski][44], Joseph Creek,
and [Jesse Creek][45]) have been working together towards purchasing Creative Coatings, and that
goal has finally become a reality. As of September 1st, we have acquired the [Creative Coatings
Co.][46]

What this means is that the four of us, along with Ron Plonkey, Anthony Citraro, and Mike Marsee,
will make up the new Creative Coatings Company. Rich Plonkey will be staying on temporarily to help
ease the transition. All of our products will continue to ship from the Michigan facility, giving us
a strong, centrally located distribution center for our expanding product offerings. Creative
Coatings Company will now be official distributors for the following product lines:

-AkzoNobel Aerospace Coatings- full tier 1 distributor
-Hentzen Coatings- full distributor
-NCP Coatings- full distributor

In addition to the above, Creative Coatings will now begin to fully stock a wide variety of coatings
and products from the following companies:

-PPG Aerospace- fully stocking both Deft and PPG Legacy items
-Spectrum Coatings

As a result, Creative Coatings Company will be increasing our inventory and carrying a wider, more
diverse selection of products from all five companies. We strive to maintain the fast turnaround
times, competitive pricing, superior customer service, and industry experience you’ve received in
the past. With over 100 years combined experience between the seven of us, we want Creative Coatings
to become the “creative” solution to all your aerospace coating needs.

Feel free to call or email us with any questions you may have regarding this transition.

We look forward to hearing back from you, and we would love the opportunity to earn your business!

### Standards

[See All][185]
[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

### Standards

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

Welcome to Impact Coatings

# Clean PVD coating solutions for a safe and sustainable society

## Explore our core areas of coating expertise, perfectly matched to your application.

Allow yourself to fully focus on your product and let us focus on what we do best – the performance,
aesthetics and functionality of the coating of your product.

## Energy solutions

Our PVD technology offers clean coating processes and allows the production of high-performing fuel
cell and electrolyzer coatings optimized for energy efficiency and long durability.

Our delivery models are flexible to meet the production needs in all development stages, which
supports new energy solutions based on fuel cell and electrolyzer technologies to scale up with
maximum control in each production phase. 

[Explore energy solutions][56]

## Metallization solutions

Impact Coatings’ solutions for plastic metallization provide unique quality control and cost
efficiency, required by modern manufacturing in the plastic and automotive industries.

PVD metallization of plastic products is growing industry-wide and plays an important role in the
phase-out of hazardous hexa­valent chromium used in traditional plating on plastic.

[Explore metallization solutions][57]

## Take advantage of three decades of experience in tailored coating solutions. We can help you
## modify look, feel, conductivity, and wear resistance to meet your unique application needs.

[Discover more applications][58]

## Impact Coatings is your well-rounded partner for coating systems, service and delivery.

At Impact Coatings we always put the customer in the center. We listen to, and work closely with you
in order to provide the solutions that best meet your PVD coating needs today and in the future.

### PVD systems

Our compact and high-capacity PVD systems enable cost-efficient coating production for a wide range
of applications. We match our system solutions with flexible delivery models to support customers in
all product development stages.

[Learn more][59]

### Coating services

We develop coating solutions perfectly matched to your application. In our modern and flexible
Coating Service Centers we offer samples for test and verification, prototyping, and small-to-mid
volume production for a wide range of products and applications.

[Learn more][60]

### Coating expertise

Take advantage of Impact Coatings’ three decades of PVD coating expertise. Experience
industry-proven coatings and production solutions for fuel cells and electrolyzers, or explore our
extensive know-how across applications.

[Learn more][61]

### Flexible delivery models

Impact Coatings is a full-service provider of PVD coating solutions. By offering flexible delivery
models we support customers and industries to lower entry barriers, speed up time to market, and
decrease technical and financial risks.

[Learn more][62]

Welcome to Impact Coatings

# Clean PVD coating solutions for a safe and sustainable society

## Explore our core areas of coating expertise, perfectly matched to your application.

Allow yourself to fully focus on your product and let us focus on what we do best – the performance,
aesthetics and functionality of the coating of your product.

## Energy solutions

Our PVD technology offers clean coating processes and allows the production of high-performing fuel
cell and electrolyzer coatings optimized for energy efficiency and long durability.

Our delivery models are flexible to meet the production needs in all development stages, which
supports new energy solutions based on fuel cell and electrolyzer technologies to scale up with
maximum control in each production phase. 

[Explore energy solutions][56]

## Metallization solutions

Impact Coatings’ solutions for plastic metallization provide unique quality control and cost
efficiency, required by modern manufacturing in the plastic and automotive industries.

PVD metallization of plastic products is growing industry-wide and plays an important role in the
phase-out of hazardous hexa­valent chromium used in traditional plating on plastic.

[Explore metallization solutions][57]

## Take advantage of three decades of experience in tailored coating solutions. We can help you
## modify look, feel, conductivity, and wear resistance to meet your unique application needs.

[Discover more applications][58]

At Impact Coatings we always put the customer in the center. We listen to, and work closely with you
in order to provide the solutions that best meet your PVD coating needs today and in the future.

### PVD systems

Our compact and high-capacity PVD systems enable cost-efficient coating production for a wide range
of applications. We match our system solutions with flexible delivery models to support customers in
all product development stages.

[Learn more][59]

### Coating services

We develop coating solutions perfectly matched to your application. In our modern and flexible
Coating Service Centers we offer samples for test and verification, prototyping, and small-to-mid
volume production for a wide range of products and applications.

[Learn more][60]

### Coating expertise

Take advantage of Impact Coatings’ three decades of PVD coating expertise. Experience
industry-proven coatings and production solutions for fuel cells and electrolyzers, or explore our
extensive know-how across applications.

[Learn more][61]

### Flexible delivery models

Impact Coatings is a full-service provider of PVD coating solutions. By offering flexible delivery
models we support customers and industries to lower entry barriers, speed up time to market, and
decrease technical and financial risks.

[Learn more][62]

## PRODUCT CATEGORIES

[COATMASTERS LOGO]
[Film Forming Sealers and Anti-Graffiti Coatings]

### Dampproof and Waterproof Coatings

**Dampproof and Waterproof Coatings** based on asphaltic-bituminous emulsion and polymer hybrids are
functional products used on specific applications, requiring certain performance characteristics.

[Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers]

### Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers

**Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers** based on hybrid systems of Silane, Siloxane, Flourinated,
Lithium and Potassium Silicates are ideal for water repellency, anti-graffiti (non-sacrificial) and
stain protection, ultra-violet, and freeze-thaw protection and overall natural appearance
preservation.

[Elastomeric Coatings]

### Elastomeric
### Coatings

**Elastomeric Coatings** based on waterbased polymeric hybrids of acrylic and silicone systems are
popular on bridging gaps and used on inside containment and vault structures for flexural tensile
strength, and have both dampproof and waterproof performance characteristics with improved visual
appearances.

[ More Info ][47]
[ More Info ][48]
[ More Info ][49]
[Film Forming Sealers and Anti-Graffiti Coatings]

### Film Forming Sealers and Anti-Graffiti Coatings

**Film Forming Sealers and Anti-Graffiti Coatings** based on acrylic hybrid polymers are
environmental compliant systems, available as a sacrificial protection solution supplied in either
clear or tinted form, and can be matched to any color standards, including common DOT Federal 595
standards.

[High Performance Epoxy Coatings]

### High Performance Epoxy Coatings

**High Performance Epoxy Coatings** based on Bisphenol A & F and higher grade types such as Novolacs
are sometimes used requiring superior chemical resistance, hydrostatic resistance, and the ability
to withstand other forms of environmental exposures on a more frequent basis.

[Integral Admixtures]

### Integral
### Admixtures

**Integral Admixtures** based on high molecular weight Silicone emulsions of various type
composition is ideal for cementitious mix designs for integral water and corrosion protection, ideal
for frequently exposed moisture conditions.

**Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers** based on hybrid systems of Silane, Siloxane, Flourinated,
Lithium and Potassium Silicates are ideal for water repellency, anti-graffiti (non-sacrificial) and
stain protection, ultra-violet, and freeze-thaw protection and overall natural appearance

### Coatings

popular on bridging gaps and used on inside containment and vault structures for flexural tensile
strength, and have both dampproof and waterproof performance characteristics with improved visual
appearances.

environmental compliant systems, available as a sacrificial protection solution supplied in either
clear or tinted form, and can be matched to any color standards, including common DOT Federal 595
standards.

**High Performance Epoxy Coatings** based on Bisphenol A & F and higher grade types such as Novolacs

## About Us

KAPCI Coatings was established in 1985 as a private company only devoted for the production of car
refinishes till 1999. We were producing Nitrocellulose car refinish till 1996 when we introduced to
the Egyptian market the most successful 2 component acrylic polyurethane color mix system for car
refinish based on our own know-how.

[Read More][41]

### HISTORY

### BUSINESS

### Strategy

### CSR

OUR BRANDS

Products

## Automotive Refinish

Automotive refinishing requires highly specialized and quality products. At Kapci Coatings we
continue to develop car refinish products that are highly innovative. Our mission is to produce
coating systems that bring solutions.

[Read More][42]

## Wood Coatings

Our wood range is specially formulated for curing, beautifying and protecting of wood surfaces. We
understand how expensive and valuable wood products can be, therefore we continue to design products
that meet the ever changing tastes.

[Read More][43]

## **Decorative Paints**

Our decorative range is used in decorating, protecting and enhancing durability in all architectural
applications, wood, metal, PVC and plastic substrates.  The products come in personalized and
versatile colours that meet the choices.

[Read More][44]

## INK

KAPCI Coatings And Sun Chemical offers a broad ink and coating product portfolio with a wide range
of capabilities that include flexographic packaging inks, energy-curable inks and coatings, label
and narrow web inks.

[Read More][45]

## Resin

The company produces a range of resins, especially Alkyd resins, which are included in many types of
paints in the way and proportion that suits the needs and requirements of these paints

[Read More][46]

## почему именно мы

Эластичность

Одна из главных задач при работе с защитными плёнками — добиться идеального результата без проблем и
сюрпризов во время установки.

Это плёнка, которая прощает «ошибки» — даже если вы немного промахнулись при первоначальной
установке, всегда можно скорректировать положение.

Самозаживление без температурной обработки

Верхний слой пленки обладает самовосстанавливающимися свойствами.

Мелкие царапины, появившиеся в процессе эксплуатации или при мойке, исчезают буквально за несколько
минут.

И всё это без использования фена или других нагревательных инструментов — естественное тепло от
солнца или воды достаточно для восстановления поверхности.

Защита от реагентов и пожелтения

Особенно актуально зимой: дорожные реагенты, соль и пескосоляные смеси — частые причины коррозии и
потери блеска ЛКП.

Плёнка KPPF 24 имеет усиленный верхний слой, который не желтеет со временем и стойко противостоит
химическим воздействиям.

Это значит, что ваша работа сохранится в идеальном состоянии даже после нескольких сезонов активной
эксплуатации.

Глубокий глянец и насыщенный цвет

Благодаря высокой прозрачности и глянцевому финишу, пленка не просто защищает, но и усиливает
визуальные эффекты лакокрасочного покрытия.

Цвет становится ярче, глубже, а поверхность — более насыщенной и «живой». Это особенно заметно на
черных и ярких автомобилях, которые получают настоящий «премиум-вид».

## почему именно мы

Эластичность

Одна из главных задач при работе с защитными плёнками — добиться идеального результата без проблем и
сюрпризов во время установки.

Это плёнка, которая прощает «ошибки» — даже если вы немного промахнулись при первоначальной
установке, всегда можно скорректировать положение.

Самозаживление без температурной обработки

Верхний слой пленки обладает самовосстанавливающимися свойствами.

Мелкие царапины, появившиеся в процессе эксплуатации или при мойке, исчезают буквально за несколько
минут.

И всё это без использования фена или других нагревательных инструментов — естественное тепло от
солнца или воды достаточно для восстановления поверхности.

Защита от реагентов и пожелтения

Особенно актуально зимой: дорожные реагенты, соль и пескосоляные смеси — частые причины коррозии и
потери блеска ЛКП.

Плёнка KPPF 24 имеет усиленный верхний слой, который не желтеет со временем и стойко противостоит
химическим воздействиям.

Это значит, что ваша работа сохранится в идеальном состоянии даже после нескольких сезонов активной
эксплуатации.

Глубокий глянец и насыщенный цвет

Благодаря высокой прозрачности и глянцевому финишу, пленка не просто защищает, но и усиливает
визуальные эффекты лакокрасочного покрытия.

Цвет становится ярче, глубже, а поверхность — более насыщенной и «живой». Это особенно заметно на
черных и ярких автомобилях, которые получают настоящий «премиум-вид».

KRYTEX AT SEMA SHOW 2023
Recognized worldwide: the KRYTEX brand was presented at SEMA SHOW 2023, one of the largest
automotive trade shows from October 31 to November 3, 2023 in Las Vegas (USA)!
[READ MORE ][66]
OUR
MISSION
We see our mission as protecting every surface with our coatings, making the use of material objects
easier and more enjoyable.
All our products are known for their innovation, but one stands out among the rest: our famous top
coat, MEGA 10. We have managed to add non-organic glass to the composition, which makes it unique.

Available exclusively for select dealers and highly professional detailers, following a special
explanatory course.
MEGA 10
TRY ONCE, USE ALWAYS
Titanium protective coating for paintwork

* Protects paint from fading and maintains its natural color
* Decreases the possibility of chipping
* Reduces risks of corrosion development
* Minimizes the risk of paintwork damage at car wash stations using low-grade chemical products and
  low-skilled personnel
* Creates an anti-graffiti effect when two layers are applied
* Enhances shine, depth and intensity of paintwork color
ADVANTAGES OF OUR COATINGS
* **Ease of Application**
  All KRYTEX™ coatings are easy and quick to apply.
* **Quick Multi-Layer Application**
  It is possible to create a multi-layered coating in the shortest possible time for maximum effect
* Long-Lasting Protection
  Our coatings offer guaranteed long-term surface protection, eliminating the need for regular
  renewal
* Chemical Resistance
  Our coatings offer guaranteed resistance to high-potency chemical exposure
* Mechanical Impact Resistance
  Our coatings provide guaranteed resistance to significant mechanical impact during normal car
  maintenance
* Certified Quality
  We have all the official documents confirming the stated features of our coatings
Our products are designed for detailing professionals, and we are confident that our future partners
and dealers are knowledgeable about detailing and protective coatings application.

Nevertheless, our coatings have some unique features that need to be understood before the
application process begins.

For everyone who starts working with KRYTEX™, we provide a special explanatory course to help you
achieve maximum results in detailing. We offer two options: a 2-day course for beginners and a 1-day
course for detailers with experience in protective coatings application.
KRYTEX™
PROFESSIONAL ASSISTANCE
KRYTEX™ sales strategy is straightforward – we only sell our coatings to our partners and
distributors. Partners (typically detailers) use KRYTEX™ products exclusively for themselves or
their customers, while distributors are entitled to resell to other companies.

We are always interested in widening of our network, so we are inviting new partners and
distributors to join our team!
To receive the conditions of becoming a partner or a distributor, please send us a message to
[info@krytexgroup.com][67] and our managers will provide you with necessary information. Join our
team!

## Why Las Cruces is hard on stucco

**The daily temperature swing never stops working the wall.** At about 3,900 feet, Las Cruces
routinely swings 30–40 degrees between afternoon and dawn. The finish coat expands and contracts
through every cycle, and over years it map-cracks — the fine spiderweb pattern you see on almost
every older elevation in town.

**Hard freezes turn hairlines into open cracks.** Las Cruces winters are milder than northern New
Mexico’s, but we still freeze dozens of nights a year — and occasionally hard. The February 2011
arctic blast dropped Las Cruces below zero for consecutive nights, burst pipes across the valley,
and put a freeze-thaw punch into every crack that was holding water. Water in a hairline crack
expands about 9% when it freezes. Multiply that by a winter of cycles and a cosmetic crack becomes a
repair.

**Spring wind season sandblasts the finish.** March through May, sustained west winds funnel dust
off the mesa across the valley. Years of that scours pigmented finish coats chalky and dull,
especially on west- and south-facing elevations — a big reason [recoating][28] demand here is real,
not manufactured.

**Monsoon finds every failure.** July through September, storms drop driving rain on walls that have
been baking since April. Open cracks, failed sealant at windows, cracked parapet caps, and rusted
canales all leak at once. Mid-summer is when “small” stucco problems announce themselves as interior
stains.

**The parapet problem.** A huge share of Las Cruces housing — especially in Mesilla Park, Alameda,
and the older midtown grid — is flat-roofed with parapet walls. The parapet cap takes sun, ponding
rain, and freeze from both faces, and drains through canales that rust and lose their flashing. When
a cap cracks, water enters the wall core and works down; by spring you see staining and spalling on
both sides. This is the highest-stakes repair in our vertical, and we treat it that way — see
[parapet repair][29].

## Three stucco systems, three different repairs

Getting the system right before touching the wall is half the job:
* **Traditional three-coat** — paper, wire lath, then roughly 3/4” of cement scratch and brown coat
  plus a finish coat. Most Las Cruces homes built before about 2000, and most custom and
  pueblo-style houses.
* **One-coat** — a single ~1/2” cement basecoat over foam sheathing. Common on newer production
  homes in Sonoma Ranch, High Range, and the East Mesa subdivisions. Thinner, so impacts and
  cracking telegraph faster.
* **Synthetic / EIFS** — foam board, fiberglass mesh in polymer cement, acrylic finish. Softer, and
  it traps water badly when sealant joints fail. EIFS gets repaired with EIFS components — never
  patched with cement stucco, and vice versa.

And a fourth that isn’t stucco at all: **real adobe**. Mesilla’s historic core and Doña Ana village
have walls of unstabilized mud brick, some standing since the 1840s–1850s. Portland cement stucco
over real adobe is a well-documented mistake — it traps moisture in the adobe and the wall
deteriorates behind the cement. Those walls need lime or mud plaster, and we’re straight with you
about it. More on the [Mesilla page][30].

## How a proper repair actually goes
1. **Sound the wall and find the cause.** We tap for hollow spots, trace cracks to their source —
   settling, a parapet cap, a rusted canale, sprinkler spray — and identify the system before
   anything gets cut.
2. **Cut back to sound material.** Failed stucco gets saw-cut and chipped out past the visible
   damage. Rusted lath and rotten paper come out. Nobody skims over a soft spot.
3. **Rebuild the weather barrier.** New paper lapped shingle-style into the existing, new galvanized
   lath tied in, flashing corrected at parapets, canales, and penetrations. This step is where cheap
   patches fail.
4. **Scratch and brown coat, properly cured.** Cement basecoats are moist-cured, and the brown coat
   sits before finishing. Rushing cure is how patches shrink-crack within a season.
5. **Finish, texture, and color.** The finish coat replicates your texture and feathers into the
   wall, and color is blended to the weathered wall in daylight, judged dry — cement finishes shift
   color as they cure.

────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────
